if: the supply is a supply of goods
tax is paid or liable to be paid on reverse charge basis
then: the time of supply is the EARLIEST of: the date of receipt of goods; the date of payment as entered in the recipient's books of account or the date the payment is debited to his bank account (whichever is earlier); and the date immediately following THIRTY days from the date of issue of invoice
note: EARLIEST of three, not earlier of two, and the clock is THIRTY days for goods. Services run sixty (GST-TIME-SERVICES-006) — mixing the two is the single most likely reverse-charge error.
